facts.value: Handles grounded Kirby copied Pikachu/Pichu Thunder Jolt animation: consumes an exact command-slot-0 release cue, makes at most one configured spawn attempt while command slot 1 stays latched, plays copy-specific firing sound regardless of the spawn return value, and calls ft_8008A2BC on animation exhaustion.
facts.rationale: Repairs exactly-once successful-creation wording using the callback and nullable spawner.

evidence.why: Complete release, sound, and completion paths.
Nullable result is ignored by caller.

facts.value: Only slot 0 exactly equal to true is consumed and cleared. If slot 1 is zero, it is set before the hat switch. Pikachu/Pichu attempt one spawn and play their sound; unsupported hats do neither. Non-one trigger values are untouched, and any nonzero latch suppresses another attempt. Spawn failure neither resets the latch nor suppresses sound. This guarantee lasts only while other writers leave slot 1 set. Independently, animation exhaustion calls ft_8008A2BC.
facts.rationale: Specifies exact boundaries, unsupported branches, failure, and local latch lifetime.

facts.value: Handles aerial Kirby copied Pikachu/Pichu Thunder Jolt animation through a cue-gated, latched spawn attempt with aerial offsets and copy-specific item/audio data. On supported-hat animation exhaustion, zero landing lag calls ftCo_Fall_Enter; nonzero lag is forwarded to ftCo_80096900, which can divert through x2224_b2 instead of entering FallSpecial. Successful item creation is not guaranteed.
facts.rationale: Qualifies nullable release and verifies the recovery callee's optional branch.

facts.value: Slot 0 exactly equal to true is cleared; a zero slot 1 is set before the hat switch. Supported hats attempt spawning and play sound even on allocation failure; unsupported hats consume/latch the cue without release. Further attempts are blocked while slot 1 stays nonzero. At animation exhaustion, either signed-zero selected lag calls ftCo_Fall_Enter; values unequal to zero, including negative values, infinities and NaN under ordinary floating comparisons, pass unchanged to ftCo_80096900. That helper calls ftCo_80090780 and returns if x2224_b2 is set, otherwise initializes FallSpecial. Unsupported hats leave landing_lag uninitialized, so completion has undefined behavior rather than a defined fallback.
facts.rationale: Repairs action-wide latch and two-terminal-path overclaims; records exact exceptional cases.

evidence.why: Trigger/latch ordering and uninitialized lag path.

facts.value: Supplies grounded fighter physics for Kirby's copied Pikachu/Pichu neutral special by forwarding gobj unchanged to ft_80084F3C. The helper conditionally scales common ground friction when absolute ground velocity is strictly above walk_max_vel, then applies friction and ground movement. Source does not establish that scaling strengthens friction.
facts.rationale: Replaces unproved multiplier-magnitude interpretation with verified operations.

evidence.why: Strict guard and ordered friction/movement calls.

facts.value: Every invocation unconditionally calls ft_80084F3C. That helper starts with co_attrs.ground_friction, multiplies by p_ftCommonData->friction_when_above_walk_speed only if ABS(gr_vel) > walk_max_vel, calls ftCommon_ApplyFrictionGround, then ftCommon_ApplyGroundMovement. Equality does not scale; unordered NaN comparison is false under ordinary floating semantics. Multiplier magnitude is unverified. The wrapper has no local timer, projectile, animation, collision, or motion-transition logic.
facts.rationale: Preserves exact data flow while removing increased-friction wording and documenting boundaries.
